1-on-1 Design Meeting

Prefer to discuss your project directly?

Schedule a 30-minute consultation with our master woodworker to review architectural drawings, timber finishes, or room dimensions.

What to Include in Your Quote

  • Room Context: Dining room, master alcove, kitchen island, etc.
  • Dimensions: Approximate width, height, and depth (e.g. 96" L × 42" W × 30" H).
  • Preferred Timber: White oak, walnut, maple, ash, or douglas fir.
  • Special Features: Integrated cable routing, brass hardware, soft-close drawers, or extending leaves.
